sophie: short follow-up from PM postmortem re: rollout safety. need owners + dates for fixes (opt-out, auto-rollback, blast-radius).
anya: i can own the emergency opt-out flag + runtime fallback to safe-models. target 2026-04-01.
mike: i'll own auto-rollback controller + CI harness. propose triggers: error_rate >=1.8% over 3m OR p95 >2s over 2m. aim 2026-04-04.
jamal: i'll do console UX for blast-radius caps (defaults: 5% x15m) and expose audit events. ETA 2026-04-08.
sophie: add KV-warmup gate for big models: require prefix-cache-hit >=70% before ramp. anyone pairing on telemetry?
mike: i'll add telemetry dims (model_family, quant_variant, region) and wire alerts. finish 2026-04-04.
triage-bot: Recurring meeting created: "Rollout safety check" weekly Mon 10:00 starting 2026-03-30.
sophie: action summary: 1) opt-out flag -> anya -> 2026-04-01; 2) auto-rollback + harness -> mike -> 2026-04-04; 3) console caps + audit -> jamal -> 2026-04-08; 4) telemetry + KV gate -> mike+anya -> 2026-04-04. I'll update postmortem and tracking sheet. Reply if missing. :white_check_mark:
